t: AI's New Deal: From Ideas to Automation
s: The article argues that Large Language Models (LLMs) act as universal translators, enabling imprecise human language to drive precise machine automation, democratizing innovation. It champions local, open-source LLMs for privacy and accessibility, predicting a societal shift akin to the Industrial Revolution.
sub: LLMs as universal translators bridging human intent and machine execution.
The value of local, open-source LLMs (Llama, Gemma) for privacy and accessibility.
Encoding ideas via journaling and text editing as a precursor to machine code.
Function execution in LLMs through prompt engineering and data structures like JSON.
